# PMG Skills Index

Skill/runtime version: v2.0.1. Published tags require exact-commit reinstall and playback retesting.
Release status: https://github.com/nphu0811/pmg-skills/releases
Future releases: v2.0.1 (Creative Motion Intelligence & Autonomous Motion Director 2.0).

Use the canonical pmg engine for production. Install its Python runtime
separately from SKILL.md files, pinned to the same verified published commit.
Do not assume host agents automatically load dependent skills. Explicitly
load relevant installed guidance and use actual available engine APIs.

## pmg-engine
- Responsibility: Create or validate animated PPTX through the canonical PMG engine. Routes professional presentation, logo-to-PPTX and reference-animation requests to installed capabilities, real PowerPoint playback and the final delivery gate.
- Triggers: professional animated PPTX; presentation from a logo; recreate slide animation from video; PMG build/validate
- Path: skills/pmg-engine/SKILL.md

## pmg-core
- Responsibility: Plan native PPTX layout, typography, geometry and readable layered composition. Allows intentional overlap; delegates production and animation compilation to the canonical PMG engine.
- Triggers: canvas, layout, typography, hierarchy, readable layers
- Path: skills/pmg-core/SKILL.md

## pmg-morph
- Responsibility: Compile technical cross-slide PowerPoint Morph, persistent !! identity matching and anchor compatibility. Used by choreography for Morph; does not own narrative sequencing or camera direction.
- Triggers: Morph XML, persistent identifiers, cross-slide object matching, anchor compatibility
- Path: skills/pmg-morph/SKILL.md

## pmg-choreography
- Responsibility: Direct narrative motion, choose effects and coordinate objects and cinematic timing. Reuses shared Morph, camera, native animation and preset engines; becomes Motion Director through the gated roadmap.
- Triggers: motion direction, narrative sequence, coordinated animation, cinematic timing, scene transitions
- Path: skills/pmg-choreography/SKILL.md

## pmg-camera-parallax
- Responsibility: Plan and apply shared virtual camera transforms, paths, pan, zoom, depth layers and multi-plane parallax. Used by 3D composition; does not own model preparation or rotation.
- Triggers: camera paths, pan, zoom, depth, parallax, camera-relative positioning
- Path: skills/pmg-camera-parallax/SKILL.md

## pmg-3d-cinematic
- Responsibility: Prepare and compose 3D assets, model orientation, technical cutaways, exploded views and annotations. Reuses the shared camera system; requires actual PowerPoint model compatibility evidence.
- Triggers: 3D models, orientation, cutaways, exploded views, model annotations
- Path: skills/pmg-3d-cinematic/SKILL.md

## pmg-glassmorphism
- Responsibility: Compose translucent acrylic PowerPoint surfaces, borders and readable overlays with intentional layering. Uses shared native shape helpers and delegates animation to the PMG engine.
- Triggers: acrylic surfaces, translucent panels, alpha, borders, readable overlays
- Path: skills/pmg-glassmorphism/SKILL.md

## pmg-qa-audit
- Responsibility: Inspect PPTX integrity, geometry, Morph anchors, native timing, assets, compatibility and playback evidence without modifying the presentation. Produces shared structured defects; does not repair or certify delivery.
- Triggers: inspect PPTX, detect defects, inspect compatibility, audit playback evidence
- Path: skills/pmg-qa-audit/SKILL.md

## pmg-review-validation
- Responsibility: Consume PMG audit defects, choose repair strategies and request fresh validation through PMGOrchestrator. Owns repair policy and certification decisions using one maximum-three-attempt technical repair budget.
- Triggers: repair PPTX, review defects, delivery gate, final certification
- Path: skills/pmg-review-validation/SKILL.md

## pmg-visual-assets
- Responsibility: Media research, authentic asset discovery (Wikimedia/NASA), licensing, provenance, and preparation; does not compile animations.
- Triggers: find images, media research, icon search, asset licensing, NASA assets
- Path: skills/pmg-visual-assets/SKILL.md

## pmg-image-decomposer
- Responsibility: Semantic, geometric, and depth decomposition of flat images into structured LayerTree hierarchies with vector/raster editability and reassembly verification.
- Triggers: decompose image, logo decomposition, slice image, shutter transition, layer tree, vector reconstruction
- Path: skills/pmg-image-decomposer/SKILL.md

## pmg-storyboard
- Responsibility: High-level narrative architecture and scene planning (narrative pacing, visual hierarchy, thematic traveling hero continuity across scenes, camera framing, and asset requirement specification); passes plan to Motion Director, no raw XML.
- Triggers: storyboard, narrative plan, scene planning, visual hierarchy, presentation flow
- Path: skills/pmg-storyboard/SKILL.md

## pmg-chart-motion
- Responsibility: Quantitative chart and numerical motion intelligence (bar growth, line draw, doughnut slice reveal, synchronized value counters, and peak metric emphasis).
- Triggers: chart animation, bar chart, line chart, doughnut chart, metric counter, animated numbers, quantitative motion
- Path: skills/pmg-chart-motion/SKILL.md

## pmg-kinetic-typography
- Responsibility: Typographic motion intelligence (authoritative title unveiling, word-by-word reading cadence, keyword scale punches, typewriter rhythms, and kinetic headline morphs).
- Triggers: kinetic typography, title animation, word stagger, keyword emphasis, typewriter text, animated headline
- Path: skills/pmg-kinetic-typography/SKILL.md

## pmg-image-motion
- Responsibility: Photographic and visual composition motion intelligence (directional unmasking, 3-plane layered parallax, controlled macro dolly zooms, cinematic pans, and before/after comparisons).
- Triggers: image animation, photo reveal, layered parallax, dolly zoom, panoramic pan, before after image, photo motion
- Path: skills/pmg-image-motion/SKILL.md

## pmg-diagram-motion
- Responsibility: Diagram and process motion intelligence (directional causal process flow, node-by-node causality, vector connector drawing, hierarchical tree expansions, and data packet throughput).
- Triggers: diagram animation, flowchart motion, process steps, connector animation, architecture flow, data pipeline motion
- Path: skills/pmg-diagram-motion/SKILL.md

## pmg-map-motion
- Responsibility: Geospatial and map motion intelligence (region highlights, progressive route drawings, location marker pin drops, hub radar pulses, and multi-location itinerary storytelling).
- Triggers: map animation, geographic motion, route drawing, location pin drop, radar pulse, territory highlight
- Path: skills/pmg-map-motion/SKILL.md

## pmg-infographic-motion
- Responsibility: Infographic, timeline, and progress indicator motion intelligence (chronological timeline spines, milestone pin reveals, horizontal progress bars, circular progress gauges, and comparison matrices).
- Triggers: infographic animation, timeline motion, milestone reveal, progress bar growth, circular gauge, feature comparison
- Path: skills/pmg-infographic-motion/SKILL.md

## Future skill routing (not yet implemented in this release)
- v1.7.0 shared Scene Graph/Motion Graph and Motion Director are APIs, not separate skills.
- v2.0.1 extends choreography/storyboard after v1.8.0; no competing director/compiler skills.
- Existing pmg.animations, cinematic_builder, reverse_engineer, video_reconstructor, worker and benchmarks are reused.
- Full ownership and release acceptance: docs/architecture.md and docs/development-roadmap.md.
